answer_1.quote: The primary objective of role-playing agents is to provide users with immersive conversations by authentically simulate characters.
answer_1.outputs: conversational responses that advance plot progression in role-playing scenarios

answer_2.quote: We measure three metrics: Fluency (Flu), Coherency (Coh), Consistency (Cons) to assess the basic conversational ability which may potentially be influenced by the plot-progression enhancement.

answer_3.quote: We instruct GPT-4o with these criteria (a detailed explanation of this prompt in Appendix D.2) and employ it as the judgement model, if an RPA's character responses meet any of these criteria for three consecutive rounds, the interaction terminates, signaling the user's diminished engagement in the dialogue.
criteria: Repetitions between the RPA's current and history replies
Ignorance of user's requests to advance the storyline / deepen relationships
Contradictions in RPA's present and previous messages
Disregard for changes in user emotions

answer_4.quote: Five annotators experienced in role-playing dialogue analysis label the script-based dialogues...
answer_4.guideline: Comprehensive guidelines to assist our human annotators to assess whether each response falls under one of the categories: Opportunity, Change of Plans, Point of No Return, Major Setback, Climax.
